verified: Ladybird's developer announced an alpha release of the browser on macOS and Linux, following more than four years of work; the browser uses an engine developed independently of Gecko, Blink and WebKit.
unconfirmed: How well the alpha renders real-world websites, its stability and performance, and any download or hardware requirements — none of these have been independently tested. The timing of a Windows build is also unstated, with The Verge reporting only that it is planned for "later stages" of the project.

verified: Kling 在 ladybird.org 发布公告，宣布 alpha 版面向 macOS 与 Linux 推出，项目已开发四年多（据 The Verge 报道）。
unconfirmed: 稳定性、网页兼容性与性能均无第三方测试数据；Windows 版本仅表示在“后期阶段”推出，没有日期；报道也未说明具体获取方式与硬件要求。

titles.en: Ladybird's from-scratch browser engine opens alpha testing on macOS and Linux
titles.zh: Ladybird 自研浏览器引擎开启 alpha 测试
